adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `minimumTokenResponseSchema` is defined with computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` and `[z.string().optional().toString()]`. In JS, `z.string().toString()` yields a plain string key (not a dynamic “any string key” constraint), and both expressions will evaluate to the same string (e.g. "[object Object]"), so the latter property overwrites the former in the object literal. As a result, the schema does not enforce “any numeric property” (expiry) at all—effectively only `access_token` is required—so responses without an expiry field can pass validation and propagate undefined expiry values downstream.
